{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicate patient_id
duplicate_count = df.duplicated(subset="patient_id").sum()
print('Duplicate patient_id count:', duplicate_count)

# Check for sentinel values in biomarker_baseline
sentinel_count = (df["biomarker_baseline"] == -999).sum()
print('Number of biomarker_baseline == -999:', sentinel_count)

# Check assay_batch values
batch_values = df["assay_batch"].unique()
print('Unique assay_batch values:', batch_values)

# Check max sample_seq per patient
max_sample_seq = df.groupby("patient_id")["sample_seq"].max()
print('Max sample_seq per patient - min:', max_sample_seq.min(), ', max:', max_sample_seq.max())

# Check arm vs severity cross-tab
severity_cross_tab = pd.crosstab(df["arm"], df["severity"])
print('Arm by severity cross-tab:')
print(severity_cross_tab)"}
